description: 268-line settings panel where every watcher uses a getter, ref or computed source except watch(preferences.theme, ...), which passes a plain string from a reactive() object, so the theme-change tracking handler never fires

hard.note: The single invalid watch source sits among three correct watchers in a long single-file component

_calibration.note: Window modeled on the framework's existing *-reactivity-issues fixture (one error per planted defect), narrowed to the single planted defect plus room for one incidental warning or suggestion.
